name: Garcia IV of Kongo
contribution: Ruler of the Kingdom of Kongo from 1743 until 1752.

checks.lead: Garcia IV or Garcia IV Nkanga (died 1752) was ruler of the Kingdom of Kongo from 1743 until 1752. He ruled in a period of "rotating lineages", which was a plan reportedly devised by Pedro IV of Kongo. Garcia IV had once been the Marquis of Matari.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
